svg.title: Layered Verification Workflow to Check If an Image Is AI-Generated
svg.desc: Four layers of verification: Layer 1 C2PA Content Credentials and SynthID watermark check, Layer 2 Reverse image search and source history, Layer 3 EXIF metadata check, Layer 4 Visual physics and text inspection.
svg.text: Layered Method to Verify Whether an Image Is AI-Generated
Layer 1: Provenance & Watermarks — C2PA Content Credentials + Google SynthID
Layer 2: Reverse Image Search — Earliest appearance date, original photographer, news wire match
Layer 3: File Metadata (EXIF/IPTC) — Camera lens data vs AI software tags (often stripped by social apps)
Layer 4: Visual Consistency — Background signage text, reflections, shadows, and uniform textures
